lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Box forty-four. Blue paper, cut on a pencil line.
lines.caption: Box 44: blue paper, cut along a pencil line, numbered with a brush.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The river is green gel. The mail bag goes in last.
lines.caption: The river is one sheet of green gel. Lee's mail bag, cut from its print, goes in last.

lines.speaker: turkey
lines.text: Are those my lost mission orders? Or is that just a sack of dirty laundry?
lines.caption: Are those my lost mission orders? Or is that only a sack of laundry?

lines.speaker: trout
lines.text: Well, shoot! A porch pirate with a vacuum? Or the mailman's truck, here at long last?
lines.caption: A porch pirate with a vacuum? Or the mailman's truck, here at last?
